data.title: 法琳 · 清泉微漾的涉水回眸
data.description: 地下城幽静绿洲中的清澈溪流，微光从高处岩洞缝隙洒在波光粼粼的水面上。法琳提起略显宽松的棉麻浅色长袍裙摆，露出白皙光洁的足踝轻轻探入清凉泉水中。她微笑着转头看向岸边，金黄色的柔顺短发在水光反射下泛着柔和光晕，神情恬静而纯美。
data.location: crystal underground cavern stream surrounded by glowing moss
data.action: wading in clear stream, lifting hem of loose linen robe revealing bare legs, water ripples, smiling over shoulder at viewer in glowing cave
data.lighting: dappled sunbeams piercing cavern ceiling mixed with glowing aquatic plants
data.mood: pastoral fantasy innocence, serene pristine beauty
data.promptProse: Wading barefoot into a crystal clear cavern stream, Faln Touden lifts the hem of her simple linen robe. Water ripples gently around her ankles as she turns with a peaceful, golden-haired smile.
data.animaCaption: Faln wading into a subterranean stream with lifted hem, smiling gently in the crystal water.
